LIA is proposed as a shared intellectual project. No particular institution, model provider, or implementation should define its
Challenging the assumptions comes second, directly after adopting the term.
Terms for extending it: keep the provenance
Revised with attribution and a visible history of revisions, LIA becomes an informational artifact that a later reader can examine the way this piece has examined its
cases. The rows are left blank on purpose.
The ambition is not to establish a single system that knows everything. It is to establish a practice through which more of what is already
available to humanity becomes intelligible, testable, and useful.
